newsitem.title: TANZANIA: SOCCER-ZAMBIA LABOUR TO 2-2 DRAW WITH TANZANIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZAMBIA LABOUR TO 2-2 DRAW WITH TANZANIA.

text.p: Under-strength Zambia laboured to a 2-2 draw with Tanzania in the Cosafa Castle Cup on Saturday but it was enough to give them top place in the standings of the southern African competition.
A face-saving equaliser seven minutes from time by Alex Namazaba secured the point to push Zambia above Mozambique and Namibia on goal difference in the five-nation tournament.
The young Zambian side, playing with just one of their foreign-based professionals, had the best of the chances in a goalless first-half.
But they went behind 11 minutes after the break when Edibilly Lunyamila headed home at a corner for Tanzania's first goal of the competition.
A fine individual effort from Masauso Tembo put Zambia level in the 71st minute. But four minutes later captain Hussein Marsha restored Tanzania's lead with a penalty.
Namazaba's strike from the edge of the box was as much as Zambia deserved but they will have much to ponder ahead of next weekend's African Nations Cup qualifier against Malawi.
After two games Zambia are level on four points with Mozambique and Namibia. But they have a slightly better goal difference than their rivals.
Mozambique play hosts to Namibia in the next match in the tournament in Maputo on July 20.
